## Docs

When a pull request changes the code of the program, the docs check asks for a change of the user manual and a change of the tech docs. A label can clear each part. The section [Which page do I update?][maps] ([source on GitHub][maps-source]) says which pages each part of the code needs, and when a label fits.

If this pull request changes no code of the program, leave both boxes empty.

- [ ] I updated the user manual (`site/content/manual/`), or this pull request needs the label `no-manual-change` (ask a maintainer to add it).
- [ ] I updated the tech docs (`site/content/tech/`), or this pull request needs the label `no-tech-docs-change` (ask a maintainer to add it).

[maps]: https://emadmokhtar.github.io/email-mcp-go/tech/work-on-the-code/local-development/#which-page-do-i-update
[maps-source]: https://github.com/EmadMokhtar/email-mcp-go/blob/main/site/content/tech/work-on-the-code/local-development.md#which-page-do-i-update
